{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Confirm missing values in body_mass_g
print(f"Missing body_mass_g values: {df['body_mass_g'].isnull().sum()}")

# Drop rows with missing body_mass_g as per constraint
filtered_df = df.dropna(subset=['body_mass_g'])

# Compute mean body mass in grams
mean_body_mass = filtered_df['body_mass_g'].mean()

print(f"Mean body mass (grams): {mean_body_mass}")"}
